summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with 36 parametrized and non-node cases plus a graph-unchanged check. Ran the new tests together with test/test_path.py using the generator venv Python: 42 passed. Nothing was committed. mypy, ruff and black are not installed in that venv and I was not allowed to install them, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only (no lines over 88 columns). Test helper parse_shape keeps long lines within 88 columns.
